article_title: Home sellers cut asking prices on 3,000 properties a day, says Rightmove

tasks.prompt: What overall change in Britain's housing market does the article describe?
options: Thousands of sellers are reducing asking prices as buyers have more choice and tighter budgets.
Most homes are selling immediately above the original asking price.
Mortgage rates have fallen to their lowest level in three years.
The number of available homes has dropped sharply.
tasks.correct_answer: Thousands of sellers are reducing asking prices as buyers have more choice and tighter budgets.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת אלפי הפחתות מחיר ביום, היצע גבוה יותר וכוח מיקוח גדול יותר לקונים בעלי תקציב מוגבל.

tasks.prompt: What was the average price reduction reported by Rightmove?
options: About 3%, or £9,000
Nearly 7%, or about £21,000
Exactly 15%, or £39,000
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ההפחתה הממוצעת הייתה כמעט 7%, השווה לכ־21 אלף ליש״ט בנכס טיפוסי.

tasks.prompt: What does “a glut of homes on the market” mean?
options: A shortage of homes available to buy
A sudden rise in mortgage approvals
An excessive supply of homes for sale
A legal ban on listing leasehold homes
tasks.correct_answer: An excessive supply of homes for sale
tasks.explanation_hebrew: glut פירושו עודף גדול; בהקשר זה יש מספר רב מאוד של בתים המוצעים למכירה.

tasks.prompt: What does “buyers were in the driving seat” mean in this context?
options: Buyers had to visit every property by car.
Buyers were responsible for valuing homes in Scotland.
Buyers were required to accept the first asking price.
Buyers had greater influence and bargaining power.
tasks.correct_answer: Buyers had greater influence and bargaining power.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: in the driving seat הוא ביטוי שמשמעותו להיות בעמדת שליטה או השפעה; ההיצע הרב מאפשר לקונים להיות בררנים יותר.

tasks.prompt: How long did homes with a price reduction typically take to find a buyer?
options: 119 days, compared with 39 days for homes kept at one price
39 days, compared with 119 days for homes kept at one price
Exactly three years
Less than one week
tasks.correct_answer: 119 days, compared with 39 days for homes kept at one price
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי נתוני Rightmove, נכס שמחירו הופחת מצא קונה בדרך כלל לאחר 119 ימים, לעומת 39 ימים לנכס שתומחר פעם אחת.

tasks.prompt: Why can a later price reduction make buyers more cautious?
options: It always proves the property has a structural fault.
It prevents buyers from obtaining a mortgage.
A long listing and later cut can make buyers wonder why the home has not sold.
Estate agents remove all photographs after a reduction.
tasks.correct_answer: A long listing and later cut can make buyers wonder why the home has not sold.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: גם כשאין בעיה בנכס, זמן רב בשוק והפחתה מאוחרת עלולים לעורר שאלות ולפגוע ברושם הראשוני.

tasks.prompt: Which figures show that supply rose while buyer demand weakened?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את שינוי מספר הבתים למכירה ואת שינוי העסקאות שסוכמו, כולל תקופת ההשוואה.
expected_points: The number of homes for sale was 5% higher in September than a year earlier.
The number of sales agreed was 9% lower over the same period.
Rightmove recorded more than 3,000 asking-price cuts per day on average during September.
Thirty-four percent of listed homes had a price reduction.

tasks.prompt: Summarise why setting a realistic initial asking price matters in the market described.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשור בין רושם ראשוני, תשומת לב של קונים פעילים, זמן מכירה ארוך, חשד לאחר הפחתה והאפשרות לקבל לבסוף פחות.
expected_points: New listings have their best opportunity to attract active buyers immediately.
An unrealistic initial price can leave a home online for months.
A later reduction may make buyers question why the property has not sold.
Correcting the price later can lead to a final offer below even the revised asking price.

tasks.prompt: Explain how higher mortgage rates affect both buyer behaviour and seller pricing.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שהחזר חודשי גבוה מצמצם תקציב, גורם לקונים להיות בררנים ומחזק לחץ על מוכרים לתמחר באופן מציאותי.
expected_points: Higher rates increase monthly mortgage costs.
Buyers therefore work within tighter affordability limits.
With many homes available, buyers can be more selective and cautious.
Sellers face stronger pressure to set realistic prices or accept reductions.

tasks.prompt: Write a neutral comparison of the Scottish and London figures reported in the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין 74% לעומת 30%, את חלון שלושת החודשים ואת הסבר ההערכה העצמאית בסקוטלנד בלי לטעון שהיא הסיבה היחידה.
expected_points: State that 74% of Scottish homes listed in April–June sold within three months, compared with 30% in London.
Mention Scotland's Home Report system and independent valuation before listing.
Explain that the valuation may guide sellers towards realistic pricing.
Avoid claiming the system alone fully explains the regional difference.
